Accessible dialogs
Focus on opener Focus inside modal · Before opening · Modal open · Confirm action · Open dialog · Close
Read the diagram step by step

Opening a native modal moves focus into the dialog and makes background content inert.
Escape or a close button dismisses it; focus should return to the opener when appropriate.
